Priya S: Quick question for the group: do we want to standardize an approval ladder for marketplace private offers that include HW rebates (e.g., appliance bundles)? Current ask: appliance + reserved commit gives partner 18% off list, but finance wants a formal ladder for >15%.
Marco T: Standard ladder sounds good. propose: <=15% product discount -> AE approve; 15-25% -> RD + Partnerships; >25% -> VP of Sales + Finance sign-off.
Ben L: Need to account for hardware rebates separately, they get capital & resale treatment. maybe treat HW rebates as non-recurring credits and keep them out of the effective discount calc for software.
Priya S: Good point. So our private-offer template needs fields: software_discount_pct, hardware_rebate_amount, effective_discount_pct (calculated). Also a note: Azure marketplace needs hardware rebate documented in the purchase order, not available as a marketplace credit. PartnerOps Bot: any gotchas per marketplace?
PartnerOps Bot: FYI: Azure PO requirement noted. AWS: appliance rebate must be invoiced; marketplace private offer only handles software SKUs. GCP: mixed bag, need manual reconciliation.
Marco T: Action: Ben to draft the approval ladder and the template fields. I'll consult finance on definitions for effective discount.
Ben L: On it. Will post draft tomorrow.
Priya S: Let's ensure we add a line: "HW rebates applied as one-time invoice credit and excluded from auto-renew discount calculations." avoids unexpected churn accounting.
PartnerOps Bot: Reminder: file the template in shared drive under Partnerships/Templates when ready. :file_folder:
Priya S: Thanks all. This should reduce back-and-forth on SI + appliance deals.
